title: The First Demon
summary: At Saint Mirren University, Ha-Jun's bullies cower before his unconscious sovereign aura. Moments later, a terrifying Greater Shadow Hound breaches the campus courtyard, targeting students. As his friend Min-Jae is about to be crushed, Ha-Jun leaps from the third story to intercept the beast.

panels.action: Wide establishing shot of Saint Mirren University in the overcast morning; crowds of students enter beneath neoclassical stone arches.
panels.prose_en: Saint Mirren University in the overcast morning; crowds of students enter beneath neoclassical stone arches.
panels.prose_hi: Badal bhari subah mein sent miren vishwavidyalay; chhatron ki bheed navashastriy patthar ke mehrabon ke neeche ragon mein utarne lagti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun walks down the brightly lit school corridor, his posture upright and confident, navy blazer immaculate.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aaj subah... sab kuch kitna saaf dikh raha hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks down the brightly lit school corridor, his posture upright and confident, navy blazer immaculate.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun chamakdar roshni wale school ke galiyare mein chalta hai, uski mudra sidhi aur aatmavishwas se bhari hui hai, navy blazer bedag hai.

panels.action: Female classmates whisper to each other behind notebooks as Ha-Jun passes: 'Woh Ha-Jun hai na? Uski chot kahan gayi?'

dialogue.text: Dekho use... kitna alag lag raha hai aaj!

panels.prose_en: Female classmates whisper to each other behind notebooks as Ha-Jun passes: 'Woh Ha-Jun hai na? Uski chot kahan gayi?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke gujarte hi mahila sahpathi notebook ke peeche ek-dusre se fusfusati han: 'vo Ha-Jun hai na? uski chot kahan gai?'.

panels.action: School bully Jin-Woo (tall, athletic, smirking arrogantly) steps out from the lockers with two cronies, blocking Ha-Jun's path.

dialogue.speaker: bully_leader
dialogue.text: Arey waah, loser! Kal ki maar se bach gaya?

panels.prose_en: School bully Jin-Woo (tall, athletic, smirking arrogantly) steps out from the lockers with two cronies, blocking Ha-Jun's path.
panels.prose_hi: Skul ka badmash jin-woo (lamba, ethletic, ahankaar se muskurata hua) do sathiyon ke saath locker se bahar nikalta hai aur Ha-Jun ka rasta rokta hai.

panels.action: Jin-Woo points a finger at Ha-Jun's chest: 'Chupchap aaj ka lunch money nikaal, warna kal se zyada bura haal karunga.'
panels.prose_en: Jin-Woo points a finger at Ha-Jun's chest: 'Chupchap aaj ka lunch money nikaal, warna kal se zyada bura haal karunga.'.
panels.prose_hi: Jin-woo ne Ha-Jun ki chhati par ungli uthai: 'chupchap aaj ka lunch money nikal, varna kal se jyada bura haal karunga.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun stops. His dark brown eyes lock onto Jin-Woo with absolute stillness, devoid of all fear or hesitation.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stops. His dark brown eyes lock onto Jin-Woo with absolute stillness, devoid of all fear or hesitation.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun rukta hai. uski gahri bhuri aankhen kisi bhi dar ya jhijhak se rahit, purna shanti ke saath jin-woo par tiki hui han.

panels.action: From Jin-Woo's terrified perspective, Ha-Jun's shadow distorts into a colossal 20-foot demonic behemoth with burning violet eyes.
panels.prose_en: From Jin-Woo's terrified perspective, Ha-Jun's shadow distorts into a colossal 20-foot demonic behemoth with burning violet eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Jin-woo ke bhaybhit drishtikon se, Ha-Jun ki chhaya jalti hui baingani aankhon ke saath ek vishal 20 foot ke shaitani demonic rakshas mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: bully stumbling backward in cold sweat
panels.action: Jin-Woo gasps in sudden terror, his knees buckling as he stumbles backward into the lockers, drenched in cold sweat.

dialogue.speaker: bully_leader
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh achanak saans lena itna mushkil kyun ho gaya...?!

panels.prose_en: Jin-Woo gasps in sudden terror, his knees buckling as he stumbles backward into the lockers, drenched in cold sweat.
panels.prose_hi: Jin-woo achanak ghabrakar hanfne lagta hai, uske ghutne mud jaate hain aur wah thande pasine mein bheegkar peeche ki or locker mein gir jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun calmly steps past the cowering bullies without uttering a single word, leaving them gasping on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Inke paas mere waqt ka ek pal bhi nahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun calmly steps past the cowering bullies without uttering a single word, leaving them gasping on the floor.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek bhi shabd bole bina shanti se dare hue badmashon ke paas se gujarta hai, jisse ve farsh par hanfne lagte han.

panels.action: In the grand university library, Ha-Jun sits by a high arched window, researching ancient demonic relics in historic volumes.
panels.prose_en: In the grand university library, Ha-Jun sits by a high arched window, researching ancient demonic relics in historic volumes.
panels.prose_hi: Bhavya vishwavidyalaya pustakalaya men, Ha-Jun ek unchi mehrabdar khidki ke paas baithkar aitihasik khandon mein prachin shaitani demonic avsheshon par shodh kar raha hai.

panels.action: Kuro's translucent spirit perches near the ceiling: 'Sahi kiya. Cheentiyon ko kuchalne mein koi shaan nahi hoti.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Cheentiyon ko ignore karna hi behtar hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's translucent spirit perches near the ceiling: 'Sahi kiya. Cheentiyon ko kuchalne mein koi shaan nahi hoti.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki parabhasi aatma chhat ke paas baithati hai: 'sahi kiya. 'chintiyon ko kuchalne mein koi shaan nahin hoti.'

panels.action: Suddenly, the heavy library window glass vibrates violently; books shudder on the mahogany shelves.
panels.prose_en: Suddenly, the heavy library window glass vibrates violently; books shudder on the mahogany shelves.
panels.prose_hi: Achanak, library ki bhari khidki ka sheesha zor se hilta hai; mahogani almariyon par kitaben thartharati han.

panels.action: All electric chandeliers in the library flicker and abruptly pop out, plunging the grand room into cold unnatural gloom.
panels.prose_en: All electric chandeliers in the library flicker and abruptly pop out, plunging the grand room into cold unnatural gloom.
panels.prose_hi: Pustkalay mein sabhi bijli ke jhoomar timtimate hain aur achanak bahar nikal jaate han, jisse bhavya kamra thande aprakritik andhkar mein doob jata hai.

panels.action: Through Ha-Jun's mana vision, creeping black frost spreads across the floorboards as temperature plummets below zero.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh aam toofan nahi hai... Abyss ki sardi hai!

panels.prose_en: Through Ha-Jun's mana vision, creeping black frost spreads across the floorboards as temperature plummets below zero.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki man drishti ke madhyam se, jaise hi taapmaan shunya se neeche girta hai, farsh par rengane wali kali thandh fail jaati hai.

panels.action: Terrified screams of hundreds of students echo up from the central quadrangle below.
panels.prose_en: Terrified screams of hundreds of students echo up from the central quadrangle below.
panels.prose_hi: Saikdon chhatron ki bhaybhit cheekhen neeche kendriya chaturbhuj se goonjati han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun throws his chair back, rushing to the open stone balustrade and looking down into the courtyard.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun throws his chair back, rushing to the open stone balustrade and looking down into the courtyard.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni kursi peeche fenkata hai, khule patthar ke chhajje ki or daudta hai aur neeche aangan ki or dekhta hai.

panels.action: A massive 15-foot black dimensional fissure tears through the center of the brick plaza, vomiting corrosive smoke.
panels.prose_en: A massive 15-foot black dimensional fissure tears through the center of the brick plaza, vomiting corrosive smoke.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vishal 15 foot ki kali aayami daraar int plaza ke kendra se hokar sanksharak dhuan ugalti hai.

panels.action: A terrifying 15-foot quadrupedal Shadow Hound claws its way out: Spiked obsidian bone-armor, three burning red eyes, jaws dripping black bile.
panels.prose_en: A terrifying 15-foot quadrupedal Shadow Hound claws its way out: Spiked obsidian bone-armor, three burning red eyes, jaws dripping black bile.
panels.prose_hi: Ek bhayanak 15 foot ka chaupaya shadow hound apne panje se bahar nikalta hai: nukile obsidian haddi-kavch, teen jalti hui lal aankhen, jabde se tapakta kala pitt.

panels.action: The beast roars into the sky; the acoustic shockwave shatters dozens of campus windows simultaneously.
panels.prose_en: The beast roars into the sky; the acoustic shockwave shatters dozens of campus windows simultaneously.
panels.prose_hi: Janvar aakash mein dahadta hai; dhwanik shockwev parisar ki darjanon khidkiyon ko ek saath tod deti hai.

panels.action: In the courtyard below, Min-Jae trips over his fallen books, scrambling desperately backward as the beast towers over him.
panels.prose_en: In the courtyard below, Min-Jae trips over his fallen books, scrambling desperately backward as the beast towers over him.
panels.prose_hi: Niche ke aangan men, min-je apni giri hui kitabon ke upar se fisalta hai aur buri tarah peeche ki or bhagta hai kyonki janwar uske upar chadh jata hai.

panels.action: The Shadow Hound raises its massive, jagged-clawed front leg to crush Min-Jae into bloody pulp.
panels.prose_en: The Shadow Hound raises its massive, jagged-clawed front leg to crush Min-Jae into bloody pulp.
panels.prose_hi: Shaido hound min-je ko khooni gude mein kuchalne ke liye apne vishal, dantedar panje wale agle pair ko uthata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes flare with incandescent violet fury: 'MIN-JAE-!!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes flare with incandescent violet fury: 'MIN-JAE-!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen garmagaram baingani rosh se chamak uthin: 'min-jaye-!!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun kicks the heavy window glass into fragments, diving out from the third floor directly into the empty air.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun kicks the heavy window glass into fragments, diving out from the third floor directly into the empty air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun bhari khidki ke sheeshe ko laat markar tukde-tukde kar deta hai aur teesri manjil se sidhe khali hawa mein gota lagata hai.

panels.action: Falling through the air, Ha-Jun channels his sovereign mana: The crystalline purple demonic gauntlet snaps around his right arm with blinding energy.
panels.prose_en: Falling through the air, Ha-Jun channels his sovereign mana: The crystalline purple demonic gauntlet snaps around his right arm with blinding energy.
panels.prose_hi: Hawa mein girte hue, Ha-Jun apne samprabhu man ko pravahit karta hai: crystaliy baingani shaitani demonic gauntlet uski dahini baanh ke charon or andhi urja ke saath ghumta hai.

panels.action: Gravity accelerates his fall into a screaming violet meteor; air pressure distorts around his diving fist.
panels.prose_en: Gravity accelerates his fall into a screaming violet meteor; air pressure distorts around his diving fist.
panels.prose_hi: Gurutvakarshan ek chikhti hui baingani ulka mein uske girne ki gati badha deta hai; hawa ka dabav uski gotakhori mutthi ke charon or vikrit ho jata hai.

panels.shot: beast shock three eyes look up
panels.action: The Shadow Hound's three crimson eyes snap upward in sudden disbelief, sensing the overwhelming sovereign wavelength descending upon it.
panels.prose_en: The Shadow Hound's three crimson eyes snap upward in sudden disbelief, sensing the overwhelming sovereign wavelength descending upon it.
panels.prose_hi: Shaido hound ki teen lal aankhen achanak avishvas mein upar ki or jhapakti han, aur apne upar aane wali bhari samprabhu tarang dairdhya ko mahsoos karti han.

panels.action: Mid-air collision: Ha-Jun's demonic gauntlet slams directly into the hound's descending paw, stopping the 15-foot beast cold in its tracks.
panels.prose_en: Mid-air collision: Ha-Jun's demonic gauntlet slams directly into the hound's descending paw, stopping the 15-foot beast cold in its tracks.
panels.prose_hi: Madhya hawa mein takkar: Ha-Jun ka shaitani demonic hathiyar sidhe shikari kutte ke utarte panje se takrata hai, jisse 15 foot ka janwar thithurkar wahin ruk jata hai.

panels.action: A 10-meter shockwave crater erupts across the brick plaza; flying debris forms a protective dome curving over Min-Jae.
panels.prose_en: A 10-meter shockwave crater erupts across the brick plaza; flying debris forms a protective dome curving over Min-Jae.
panels.prose_hi: Int plaza ke paar 10 meter ka shockwev crator foot pada; udta hua malba min-je ke upar ek surakshatmak gumbad banata hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae stares up from the ground in stunned awe at the back of the student who just saved his life.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae stares up from the ground in stunned awe at the back of the student who just saved his life.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je stabdh vismay se jameen se upar us chhatra ki or dekhta hai jisne abhi-abhi uski jaan bachai hai.

panels.action: Epic standoff cliffhanger: Ha-Jun stands tall over Min-Jae, his crystalline purple gauntlet flaring with violet lightning as he glares down the snarling 15-foot beast: 'Mere dost ko chhoona bhi mat.'
panels.prose_en: Epic standoff cliffhanger: Ha-Jun stands tall over Min-Jae, his crystalline purple gauntlet flaring with violet lightning as he glares down the snarling 15-foot beast: 'Mere dost ko chhoona bhi mat.'.
panels.prose_hi: Mahakavya gatirodh clifahenger: Ha-Jun min-je ke upar lamba khada hai, uska crystaliy baingani gauntlet baingani bijli ke saath chamak raha hai kyonki wah 15 foot ke janwar ko ghurte hue dekhta hai: 'mere dost ko chhuna bhi mat.'
